selection_identity: Retain original voltage windows, 2 mm row bands, 30% pair asymmetry and 25% spacing tolerance. Require a complete supported chain and apply the existing spacing tolerance to adjacent gaps on EACH side, including the origin-to-first gap. Unresolved shallow saddles and edge profiles remain detected and measured but cannot certify independent members of a consecutive 1D chain. Rank supported count, then the fixed Euclidean mean radius of first anchors, then the existing geometric cost; identical anchor UIDs cannot gain preference through ray tilt. Isolated inner components do not lock an otherwise complete outer chain and remain unassigned. Preserve same-support angular and radial families as alternatives, without counting a repeated primary chain as independent evidence. No integrated signal ratios or fitted-model scores enter selection. Keep all original flags and coordinates; physical diffraction orders remain conditional. Unavailable complete chains retain partial observations for 2D exclusion only. Original lattice, reflection, coverage and corner-interval gates remain unchanged.
reflection_aperture_policy: Measured signed integrals retained; primary spectra compare the common clean UID set; per-aperture clean spectra are separate named diagnostics. Horizontal ratios use their own aperture-specific gate.
